_comment: Carrier rater mapping — canonical attribute -> target cell in the carrier's Excel rater. The 'WHERE to write' for Safe Excel Autofill. Config-driven: add a carrier or change a cell without touching code. Select the active carrier with NEVAG_DEFAULT_CARRIER; override this file's path with NEVAG_CARRIER_MAPPING_PATH. Each carrier may set a 'sheet' (else the active sheet is used) and an optional 'workbook' default template path.
